steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Change the default event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title so publishing can proceed.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the requested CYLINDER product and set its quantity to 10.
Complete the pricing sheet fields required for publishing.
Add the available QA test vendor required for publishing and vendor-column generation.
Publish the RFQ before attempting the bid-template download.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Click the bid-template download control on the published stage; the catalog does not confirm its exact label.
Assert that a file was downloaded.
